hints.title: What changes at one node?
hints.body: Swapping the two child references at a node is the entire local operation.

hints.title: Apply everywhere
hints.body: Every node needs the same swap. A traversal reaches each node exactly once.

hints.title: Order does not matter
hints.body: Swap a node, then push its children for the same treatment. Return the original root.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
function flip(node):
    if node is null: return null
    swap node.left and node.right
    flip(node.left)
    flip(node.right)
    return node
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution.
